blocks.title: Feedback mechanism
blocks.text: Feedback mechanism aisa nizami amal hai jis mein nizam ka output khud nizam ki sargarmi ko qaboo karne ke liye istemal hota hai.

items: Negative feedback: output nizam ki sargarmi kam karta hai. Yeh qaboo ki sab se aam shakal hai, jo darja-e-hararat, khoon mein glucose aur hormones ka ifraz qaboo karti hai. Darja-e-hararat 37 C ke set point se barhe to hypothalamus ke thermoreceptors thermoregulatory centre ko signal dete, jo paseene ke glands ko signal deta hai; paseena darja-e-hararat kam karta, aur set point par wapas aane par receptors signal band kar dete hain.

Positive feedback: output nizam ki sargarmi barhata aur asal muharrik (stimulus) ko mazboot karta hai. Yeh kam aam hai aur wahan hota hai jahan tez, bari tabdeeli chahiye, jaise khoon jamna aur bachche ki paidaish. Rahim ke sukarne hypothalamus ko impulses bhejte, pituitary oxytocin nikalta, oxytocin mazeed tez sukarne paida karta, aur yeh chakkar bachcha paida hone tak chalta hai.

blocks.text: Be-qaboo positive feedback bimari paida kar sakta hai: sakht infection ya sozish (inflammation) mein immune cells cytokines naam ke proteins nikalte hain jo immune response ko mazeed barhate hain, aur agar yeh qaboo na ho to had se zyada sozish aur tissues ko nuqsan ho sakta hai.

blocks.alt: Oopar: paanch dabbe, tabdeeli se receptors, control centre aur effectors ke zariye set point ki bahali tak, aur surkh line wapas shuru tak. Neeche baen: zyada garmi ka negative feedback loop, 37 C se zyada darja-e-hararat se paseene aur wapas 37 C tak. Neeche daen: bachche ki paidaish ka positive feedback loop, rahim ke sukarne se hypothalamus aur oxytocin ke zariye mazboot tar sukarne tak.
blocks.caption: Homeostasis ke ajza aur feedback ki do qismein (topic 13.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Andaruni ya bairooni mahol ki tabdeeli receptors pakarte aur hypothalamus jaise control centre ko batate hain; control centre effectors, yaani muscles ya glands, ko signal deta hai jin ka rad-e-amal jism ko set point par wapas lata hai, aur nateeja wapas receptors tak jata hai. Negative feedback mein nateeja signal band kar deta hai: darja-e-hararat 37 C se barhe to paseene ke glands paseena banate hain jab tak darja-e-hararat wapas na aaye aur receptors signal band na kar dein. Positive feedback mein nateeja signal ko mazboot karta hai: paidaish ke waqt rahim ke sukarne se oxytocin nikalta hai jo mazeed tez sukarne paida karta hai, jab tak bachcha paida na ho.

blocks.prompt: Positive feedback loop kabhi kabhi khatarnak kyun hota hai? Kitab ki misal dijiye.
blocks.explanation: Kyunke yeh khud ko barhata rehta hai; jab tak koi cheez na roke, rad-e-amal be-qaboo hota jata hai. Sakht infection mein nikalne wale cytokines immune response ko barhate rehte hain jab tak sozish tissues ko nuqsan na de.

items: Negative feedback tabdeeli ulat deta (darja-e-hararat, glucose); positive feedback use barhata hai (paidaish, khoon jamna).
